sources: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233896 (read 2026-11-06): 'Sylvan Park Campground is located below the dam at Wilson Lake ... A few campsites overlook the Saline River exiting the dam, while a handful of other sites overlook the Old Saline River channel'; 'offers 27 reservable modern campsites, along with an 8-site group camp area and large group picnic shelter ... Most campsites offer sweeping views of the surrounding prairie, in addition to a handful of sites which offer a beautiful view of the Saline River'; amenities Entrance Station, Flush Toilets, Playground, Showers; facility_phone 785-658-2551; rules maxStay 14 'Rolling 30 Days', minWeekendStay 2 ('Ignore Holidays'), minHolidayWeekendStay 3, reservationCutOff 0; notice 'Sites may be available on a first come, first served basis outside of the reservation window'.

https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233896/rates (read 2026-11-06): Peak Season 2026-05-15..2026-09-15 STANDARD ELECTRIC $26, electric+water+sewer $28, STANDARD NONELECTRIC $18; 'First-come, First-served Season Walk In' 2026-01-01..05-14 and 2026-09-16..12-31 STANDARD ELECTRIC $20, STANDARD NONELECTRIC $10 (same pattern 2027).

https://www.recreation.gov/api/search/campsites?fq=asset_id%3A233896&size=1000 (read 2026-11-06): 25 family sites 01-25 (24 standard electric, 09 non-electric), all reservable, paved, 60-137 ft, pull-throughs 02-08 and 14-25; 30 A on 01-13, 50 A on 14-25 (accessible); water on every electric site; sewer on 12 and 13 ($28); group site GS2 (8 sites) and day-use shelter GS1.

Esri World Imagery 2026-11-06 (400 m and 900 m frames with the rec.gov site points) and USGS NAIP 2026-11-06 (200 m frame at 38.9693,-98.4905): the campground is downstream of the Wilson Dam embankment; the Saline River leaves the stilling basin in a straight riprapped outlet channel whose water is only ~10-13 m wide; the east-side pads (01, 03, 08, 09) are ~40-60 m from it behind the park road, a tree line and the riprap bank.

flags: WATERFRONT DOWNGRADE (riverview -> not waterfront; apply.py does not write waterfront): the campground is below Wilson Dam (no lake value). The water it 'overlooks' is the Saline River's straight riprapped outlet channel, ~10-13 m of water on NAIP at 38.9693,-98.4905 (4.5 px/m), so it is creek-size by the ~30 m rule and riverview does not apply (no creek-view value exists). The nearest pads (01 38.968663,-98.491493; 03 38.968981,-98.491307; 08 38.969459,-98.491412; 09 38.969650,-98.491262) are ~40-60 m from it behind the park road, a tree line and the riprap bank. rec.gov's 'a few campsites overlook the Saline River' is the only support and is operator prose. The 'Old Saline River channel' lies north-west by the group area, well away from the family sites.
